name: kaggle-competition
description: End-to-end Kaggle competition workflow for the best rule-compliant score: rules and FAQ ledger as a hard gate, research of the newest strong models and past winning solutions, leak-free validation that tracks the leaderboard, one-lever-at-a-time experiments with an experiment log, ensembling and robust thresholds, reproducible notebooks that fit the runtime limit, professional notebook writing, and lessons carried from one competition to the next.
